newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cert coffee fall 24,391 bags in Oct 18 week.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cert coffee fall 24,391 bags in Oct 18 week.

text.p: U.S. certified coffee stocks fell by 24,391 60-kg bags, or more than 80 percent, in the week ended October 18, leaving just 5,583 bags in exchange warehouses, the Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange said Monday.
In addition, the CSCE reported there was no coffee pending certification.
The steep drawdown came as a surprise to many operators, who had expected a small stock decline similar to those seen in recent weeks.
Last week, CSCE stockpiles declined by 750 bags to set a 12-year low of 29,974 bags. No information was immediately available from the Exchange on how current levels compared historically.
But some traders said the draw may have been anticipated, noting the sharp surge in coffee futures on Monday.
CSCE December coffee ended up 3.90 cents a lb, to 113.00 cents on Monday, while March coffee closed 2.50 cents higher, at 104.05 cents.
